info.title: blakSOC API
info.description: Versioned REST API for service identities. Every call runs through the same permission checks, tenant row-level security and tamper-evident audit trail as the web app, with the service identity as the actor.

post.summary: Exchange service identity client credentials for a bearer token valid for 15 minutes (client_credentials grant). Client authentication by HTTP Basic or form fields.

client_id.description: Omit when using HTTP Basic client authentication

get.summary: Alerts in the identity's tenant scope, highest risk first

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Restrict to one tenant in the identity's scope

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated, any of: NEW, TRIAGING, INVESTIGATING, ESCALATED, CONTAINED, RESOLVED, FALSE_POSITIVE

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Comma-separated, any of: informational, low, medium, high, critical

parameters.name: lane
parameters.description: active: the triage queue; passive: known noise. Omit for both

post.summary: Close the pattern's open informational–medium alerts (not on an incident, no intel match) as false positives. Guardrails: ≥10 alerts closed by analysts in 90 days, ≥80% false positive, no escalation in 30 days, the act switch on, 20,000 closures a week platform-wide. 409 when acting is off; 422 when a guardrail refuses.

put.summary: Replace the agent's own notes if `version` is current (409 otherwise). Notes that look like they hold emails, IP addresses or host names are refused with 422.

version.description: The version last read; a stale one is refused with 409

notes.description: The agent's complete set of model/outcome notes (at most 500, 2000 characters each): with id updates, without id adds, omitted removes. human notes are ignored and always kept.

oauth2.description: Scopes are blakSOC permissions. A token carries every scope its identity holds; an identity never holds more than its creator.

error.description: Machine-readable code, e.g. invalid_token, insufficient_scope, not_found

authorName.description: Null when a service identity wrote the note

tenantRef.description: Stable pseudonym of the tenant; never its name or id

ruleLevel.description: Wazuh rule level, else the source's native severity; 0 when unknown

byDay.description: UTC days, oldest (partial) first, ending today; sums to total

analystOverrides.description: Agent actions on this pattern analysts undid, plus alerts they reopened

coFiring.description: Rules firing in the same tenant in the same UTC hour: count of such tenant-hours, distinct tenants. Top 5.
